Name: Geode Info Menu
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Geode Info Menu[/size]

[size=4]This mod adds a menu to the game that
[list]
[*][size=4]shows you the next 20 items that normal, frozen, magma, and omni geodes will drop.[/size]
[*][size=4]has a search box that lets you see how many geodes it will take to open in order to get a certain item[/size]
[*][size=4]adds a purple star to minerals and artifacts which you have yet to donate to the museum.[/size]
[/list][/size]
[size=3]Config Options
[list]
[*][size=3]Press k (you can change this by editing config.json) to open the menu.[/size]
[*][size=3]The next 20 items are shown by default for each geode (you can change this by editing config.json).[/size]
[*][size=3]You can also turn off the purple stars.[/size]
[*][size=3]Open README.txt to see an explanation for every config option.[/size]
[/list]
[b]In the search box, you'll see a type of geode and a number next to it. That means you need to break that number of geodes total, with the last one being the type you see. So if you see 47 Magma Geodes, you could open 46 normal Geodes and then 1 Magma Geode to get that drop.[/b]

In the newest version, you can now open the menu while you're breaking open geodes![/size]

This mod requires[url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases] SMAPI[/url] by Pathoschild. To install the mod, place the GeodeInfoMenu folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url]
